evidence_chain.claim: In Q1 2026, revenue was $192.1M, up 6% year over year; recurring revenue grew 7%; recurring revenue represented 96% of total revenue; recurring revenue customers were about 54,200; and ARPU was about $13,550.
evidence_chain.source: SPS Commerce Q1 2026 financial results / Q1 2026 10-Q

evidence_chain.claim: The 10-Q says setup fees are specific to each customer connection with a trading partner, many customers have numerous trading partners, and setup fees create a renewal incentive because they are not incurred again upon renewal.

The same 10-Q says revenue growth was driven primarily by an increase in recurring revenue customers due to business acquisitions and continued business growth; it also says about 8,500 recurring revenue customers were added in February 2025 via the Carbon6 acquisition.
Q4 2025 revenue grew 13% and recurring revenue grew 14% year over year, and management said the quarter marked the company's 100th consecutive quarter of topline growth.
In Q1 2026, management launched MAX and described it as embedded into existing supply-chain workflows and powered by proprietary network data.
As of 2026-06-12, the cached finance snapshot showed market cap of about $2.06B, placing SPSC in the small-cap bucket.

falsification_plan: If the next filings show weak organic growth after excluding acquisitions, downgrade the chokepoint thesis.
If 1P recurring customer growth stalls or 1P ARPU keeps falling, the network-depth argument weakens.
If management commentary shifts from workflow embedding and cross-sell to price pressure, churn, or competitive displacement, treat the moat as overstated.
If trading-partner connection intensity or customer expansion stops improving, the company looks more like a cyclical SaaS vendor than a durable infrastructure layer.
deep_reports.hidden_signal_to_verify: Verify whether the latest filings still show high recurring-revenue mix, growing 1P customer depth, stable or rising ARPU excluding acquisition effects, expanding trading-partner connections, and management evidence that workflow usage is deepening rather than merely shifting through M&A. The exact upgrade evidence would be: clearer organic growth disclosure, stronger 1P ARPU, retention or NRR support, and rising transaction/connectivity intensity per customer. The exact falsifier would be: weak organic growth after excluding acquisitions, falling 1P usage, deteriorating ARPU, or comments pointing to competitive displacement.
next_research_tasks: Read the latest 10-K and 10-Q for any explicit organic-growth, retention, churn, or NRR disclosure.
Pull the earnings-call transcript and extract management language on trading-partner growth, customer usage depth, and any supplier or retailer budget weakness.
Check whether Carbon6-related revenue is still distorting growth and whether the business can separate acquired versus organic contribution more clearly.
Look for any quantitative evidence of transaction volume, connection count, implementation depth, or cross-sell expansion per customer.
risks: A meaningful part of recent growth may be acquisition-assisted rather than purely organic.
ARPU declined 2% in Q1 2026, partly because lower-ARPU 3P customers increased, which can dilute quality if not offset by stronger 1P depth.
Q2 2026 guidance implies slower growth than Q4 2025, which raises the risk that the business is normalizing rather than accelerating.
The public pack does not show full retention or NRR disclosure, so the network moat must still be proved rather than assumed.
deep_reports.supply_chain_position: Consumer demand -> retailer/order management -> supplier onboarding -> EDI and compliance mapping -> order/invoice execution -> SPS recurring network subscriptions + setup fees
deep_reports.thesis_cn: 核心假设：SPS Commerce 不是在卖消费者流量，而是在卖零售商与供应商之间持续接入的交易网络。若其 EDI 集成、合规映射、订单/发票流程和多交易伙伴连接仍然高度粘性，那么它就是 Consumer 供应链里的基础设施层，而不是普通 SaaS。当前最需要验证的是：增长中有多少来自真实的网络扩张与客户深度使用，有多少来自并购；以及 1P 客户的 ARPU 和交易深度是否继续支撑网络效应。
deep_reports.thesis_en: Core hypothesis: SPS Commerce is selling persistent connectivity between retailers and suppliers, not consumer demand itself. If its EDI integrations, compliance mapping, order/invoice workflows, and multi-trading-partner connections remain sticky, it is an infrastructure layer inside the Consumer supply chain rather than a standard SaaS vendor. The key test is how much growth is driven by genuine network expansion and deeper customer usage versus acquisition contribution, and whether 1P customer ARPU and workflow depth continue to support the network-effect thesis.
deep_reports.title_cn: 零售供应链的隐形闸门：SPS Commerce
deep_reports.title_en: The invisible gatekeeper in retail supply-chain workflows: SPS Commerce
deep_reports.why_underfollowed: Inference: the market can easily screen SPSC as generic vertical SaaS or back-office middleware, so it may miss that the economically important asset is embedded retailer-supplier connectivity. It is also a small-cap name, which tends to receive less attention than consumer-facing brands or mega-cap retail platforms.

facts: Recurrence customer base about 54,200 and ARPU about $13,550.
MAX launched and described as embedded into existing supply-chain workflows.
Setup fees are tied to each customer connection with a trading partner.
Many customers have numerous trading partners.
Revenue growth was driven primarily by increased recurring revenue customers due to acquisitions and continued business growth.
About 8,500 recurring revenue customers were added in February 2025 via Carbon6.
Management described it as the 100th consecutive quarter of topline growth.

memory_update: Track SPS Commerce as a consumer supply-chain infrastructure candidate, not a consumer brand.
Key monitor set: recurring revenue mix, 1P versus 3P customer mix, ARPU, organic growth versus acquisition contribution, and any disclosure of trading-partner or transaction-depth metrics.
Latest official anchors used: Q4/FY2025 results dated 2026-02-12, Q1 2026 results dated 2026-04-30, and Q1 2026 10-Q filed 2026-04-30.
summary: CN: 这份 Layer 5 结论把 SPS Commerce 视为 Consumer 主题里的“交易基础设施”而不是普通垂直 SaaS：它卡在零售商与供应商之间的订单、发票、合规映射和 trading-partner 接入层。证据质量对“粘性工作流/高重复收入”较强，但对“护城河到底有多深”仍属中等，因为公开材料里没有完整披露 retention/NRR。EN: The core read is that SPS Commerce is consumer supply-chain infrastructure, not a consumer brand or pure vertical SaaS. The key open question is whether its embedded network and recurring contracts represent a durable chokepoint versus an acquired-growth-heavy workflow vendor.
